name: Sunrise Walk
description: Start the day with a relaxed sunrise walk along a safe public waterfront or park route.

name: Coffee Shop Study Session
description: Spend a focused study block in a quiet cafe and use a simple task list to stay productive.

name: Public Museum Visit
description: Explore local history, art, and community exhibits while taking notes on interesting displays.

name: Neighborhood Photo Walk
description: Practice composition by photographing architecture, plants, signs, textures, and public spaces.

name: Budget Meal Hunt
description: Try a new affordable meal and rate it for taste, value, service, and overall experience.

name: Library Reading Hour
description: Choose a book or article and complete one uninterrupted hour of reading in a public library.

name: Local Market Visit
description: Explore a local market and observe products, prices, customer flow, and community activity.

name: Park Picnic
description: Prepare a simple meal and enjoy a low-cost picnic at a nearby public park with proper cleanup.

name: Home Movie Night
description: Plan a low-cost movie night at home with snacks and a short review after watching.

name: Street Food Sampling
description: Sample a few familiar street-food options from clean vendors and compare flavor and value.

name: Sketching Session
description: Bring a notebook and sketch a building, object, or scene using basic shapes and shading.

name: Playlist and Journaling
description: Create a short playlist and write a one-page reflection about the week, goals, or ideas.

name: Community Sports Hour
description: Join or organize a casual badminton, basketball, or walking session in a public recreation area.

name: Simple Recipe Challenge
description: Cook one simple recipe using a fixed budget and document the ingredients, process, and result.

name: Digital Declutter
description: Organize downloads, screenshots, browser bookmarks, and important files into clear folders.
